spans.s:
दैन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Diurnal, daily, relating to a day.
 n. (-नं) Poverty,
wretchedness.
 E. दीन or दिन and अण् aff.

दैनन्दिन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Diurnal, quotidian.
 E. दिनदिन day by day अण् aff.

दैनन्दिनप्रलय m. (-यः) Destruction of the world after fifteen years of
BRAMHA'S age.
 E. दैनन्दिन, and प्रलय destruction.

दैनार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Bought with a Dinar, of the value of one, &c. E.
दीनार, and अण् aff.

दैनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Diurnal, of or relating to a day.
 f. (-की) A day's
hire wages.
 E. दिन a day, affix ठञ् ।

दैन्य n. (-न्यं)
 1. Meanness, covetousness.
 2. Poverty, humbleness.
 E. दीन
a pauper, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
